show.title: One Stage. Dreams. Two Nights.
show.p1: RÉVÉLATION is Cégep Limoilou's first-ever student talent gala. Two extraordinary evenings at the Salle Sylvain-Lelièvre: the semifinal on October 1, 2026 and the grand finale on October 22, 2026, from 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM.
show.p2: A professional jury evaluates each performance. The RÉVÉLATION Grand Prize awards a $1,000 scholarship to the most outstanding talent of the evening.
show.p3: Multi-camera production. The grand finale will be streamed live on Twitch. A production worthy of our artists' ambitions.

auditionCall.title: What if it's your turn to shine?
auditionCall.description: Cégep Limoilou students across any of the 3 campuses (Charlesbourg, Québec or Des Arts): submit your online video pre-audition and seize your chance to perform on Quebec's finest student stage.
auditionCall.inPersonInfo: In-person audition: Tuesday, September 15, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM, Salle Montaigne, Cégep Limoilou Campus Charlesbourg.

ticketing.title: Reserve your place in the spotlight.
ticketing.description: Two unforgettable evenings — semifinal on October 1 and grand finale on October 22, 2026. Salle Sylvain-Lelièvre, from 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM.

jury.title: A jury worthy of your talent.

scholarships.title: More than a contest. A springboard.
scholarships.grandPrixDesc: Awarded to the most outstanding talent of the grand finale. A scholarship to propel your art.
scholarships.originalityDesc: Celebrates creative boldness and artistic uniqueness.
scholarships.audienceDesc: Chosen by the audience in the room. Your talent, their choice.

finalCall.quote: RÉVÉLATION doesn't discover talent. It gives them the stage they already deserve.
